Question 1 of 11
What is the primary function of a Buchholz relay in an oil-immersed power transformer?
A. Detects internal incipient gas accumulation and severe oil surge faults
B. Provides overvoltage surge diversion during atmospheric lightning strikes
C. Regulates magnetic core flux density at fifth harmonic frequencies
D. Monitors dielectric cooling oil recirculation flow velocity
Correct!
The Buchholz relay is a gas-actuated protective device installed in the pipe connecting the main transformer tank and the conservator tank. It detects slow gas buildup from minor insulation breakdown as well as sudden oil surges caused by severe internal short-circuit faults.
